incident-bot: PAGER: p95 latency SLO breach detected (service: inference-router, region: us-west) — auto-routing rebalancer triggered 3x in last 6m :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): on it, paging eng-sre + runtime. how bad is the roll? any customer-facing errors?

miguel: seeing p95 jump from ~350ms -> ~1.8s for a subset of requests. rebalancer moved ~18% traffic off us-west to eu-west, then back, then to ap-south. looks like hysteresis is too low so it flips on every p95 window.

priya: confirm. replaying metrics: sequence length distribution shifted (longer tails) from a recent rollout to variant v2-q4. latency for v2-q4 is higher on long contexts on ampere nodes. the smart-routing policy prefers lower cost variant and tries to avoid region with lower SLOs, but because p95 blips, the policy oscillates.

alice (oncall): immediate mitigation proposals?

miguel: short-term: disable SLO-triggered rebalancing (turn off auto-rebalance policy) and pin traffic to stable variant (v1-fp16) until we stabilize. medium: increase hysteresis windows + add consecutive-window requirement.

priya: agree. also suggest we throttle model-variant switch by adding a min-window of 10m and requiring 2 consecutive windows breach.

alice (oncall): tom, are there customer-facing errors or complaints coming in?

tom (support): support queue shows 4 P1s from customers in us-west complaining about slow completions. no failures, just high latency. sending templated ETA update to those accounts now.

chloe (product): which customers impacted? can we scope by token usage and SLA? we need to notify any enterprise accounts if >10% of their requests were affected.

priya: query results: enterprise-123 (~12% of their tokens this hour), partner-x (~6%). I can run a targeted rerun to double-check exact request mix and timestamps.

alice (oncall): execute short-term mitigation. Miguel, can you flip the policy? Priya, pin model variant. I'll update incident channel.

miguel: executing now. running command:```\n# disable SLO auto-rebalance for inference-router\ninfractl routing set-policy --service inference-router --policy slo-auto-rebalance --enabled false --reason "mitigation - oscillation"\n```\ndeploy-bot: config change applied by miguel at commit 9f3a2c4 (infractl) — rollout started.

priya: pinning route variant:```\n# pin default model variant to v1-fp16 for us-west\nruntimectl route update --service inference-router --region us-west --model-variant v1-fp16 --sticky true --ttl 15m\n```\ndeploy-bot: runtime change applied by priya at commit a7b1d2e (runtimectl) — traffic steering update complete.

alice (oncall): monitoring p95 and reroute count.

miguel: within 90s after pin, p95 in us-west dropped back to ~420ms. reroute events fell to 0/min. looks stable so far.

alice (oncall): good. next steps:
- keep auto-rebalance disabled for 30m
- leave v1-fp16 pinned for 15m and then evaluate
- prioritize a change to rebalancer config (increase hysteresis to 10m, require 2 consecutive windows)
- engineering post-incident to root-cause the model-variant perf regression and add better canary gating on model rollout

chloe (product): please add customer comms draft to the incident doc. I'll review.

tom (support): sent initial notification to impacted list. saved draft in incident doc.

priya: for RCAs: the v2-q4 variant uses a new attention kernel we enabled last week; perf is fine for shorter sequences but regresses on longer ones on A100; need to differentiate perf profiles in model catalog so routing knows which variant is safe for long-context workloads.

miguel: owners noted. I’ll prepare config PR to change rebalancer defaults:```\n# proposed rebalancer defaults\nhysteresis_window: 600  # seconds\nconsecutive_windows_required: 2\nmax_rebalances_per_hour: 3\n```\nalice (oncall): filing incident ticket and handing off to eng-oncall for follow-up. current status: mitigated, customer impact limited, ongoing investigation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-1872 — severity: P2 — owner: eng-oncall — link: https://incidents.example.com/INC-2026-1872

alice (oncall): thanks team. Miguel/Priya please coordinate a fix and post timeline. support/product: continue customer comms. I'll remain available for the next 30m for rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

miguel: will open PR this sprint and add e2e that exercises long sequences on v2-kernels.

priya: will add model-catalog metadata and a perf test for 2k token tails.

chloe (product): tracking impact and comms.

alice (oncall): closing this slack thread for now — updates will continue on INC-2026-1872.

deploy-bot: audit: config changes (2) applied by miguel, priya. summary: auto-rebalance disabled, model-variant pinned.
